This appeal coming on for judgment this day, the court   following:
 JUDGEMENT I.A.No.2817/2021 which is an application for condonation of delay of 518 days in filing this appeal.
2] For the reasons mentioned therein, I.A.No.2817/2021 stands allowed.
Delay of 518 days is hereby, condoned.
3] Heard finally with the consent of the parties.
Nirmal vs Mahesh on 13 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/28238063/

1 4] This appeal has been preferred by the appellant/claimant -Nirmal under Section 173 of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 against the award dated 25/07/2019, passed in Claim Case No.123/2016 by the II Member, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Mandleshwar.
District Mandleshwar (M.P.) seeking enhancement of the compensation amount of Rs. Rs.5,61,927/- awarded to the appellant by the Tribunal.

5] In brief, the facts of the case are that on 22/07/2016, Appellant- Nirmal along with other co-passenger were travelling in a Bolero Jeep bearing registration No.MP10T1341, at that time near village Khangaon at Kasrabad, Mandleshwar, they met with an accident as the driver of the Bolero Jeep, driving rashly and negligently, turned it turtle, as a result of which, the occupants of the jeep suffered various injuries.
So far as Appellant- Nirmal is concerned, his Radius and Ulna bones of Left hand hand were fractured, and a rod was also inserted in his hand.

Subsequently, a claim case was preferred before the Claims Tribunal, and the Claims Tribunal, after recording the evidence, has awarded compensation of Rs.5,61,927/-, and being aggrieved of inadequacy of the same, this miscellaneous appeal has been filed.
6] Learned counsel for the appellant has submitted that the income of the injured has been considered as Rs.4,000/-only, and the future prospects are also on the lower side.
It is also submitted that the under non-pecuniary head also, the amount is on lower side.
Thus, it is submitted that the award be appropriately enhanced.
7] Counsel for the respondents/Insurance Company, on the other hand have opposed the prayer, and it is submitted that the award is just and proper and no interference is called for.

8] Having considered the rival submissions, and on perusal of the record, it is found that the appellant- Nirmal was a barber by profession, and thus, his income of Rs.4,000/- per month appears to be on lower side, and in-fact, can be taken as Rs.5,500/-, and accordingly, the future prospects shall also be enhanced, and so far as the compensation awarded towards non pecuniary heads are concerned, the same also needs to be enhanced appropriately.

The assessment in this regard can be made in the following manner as compared to the assessment made by the Claims Tribunal :-
The assessment made by the claims Tribunal:-
Permanent disablement: Income taken Rs.4000/- +1600(40% Future Prospects)
=Rs.5600/- X 12=67,200/- per annum X 25% (P.D) x 18 (multiplier) X Rs.3,02,400/-
 Medical Expenses: Rs.2,30,527/-
 Pain & suffering: Rs.15,000/-
 Special diet: Rs.10,000/-
 Loss of Income: Rs.4,000/-
 Total Rs.5,61,927/-

The assessment made by this Court is as under :-
Permanent disablement: Income taken Rs.5500/- +2200(40% Future Prospects)
Nirmal vs Mahesh on 13 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/28238063/
2 =Rs.7,700/- X 12=92,400/- X 25% (P.D) x 18 (multiplier)= Rs.4,15,800/-
 Medical Expenses: Rs.2,30,527/-
 Loss of Income: Rs.16,500/- (for 3 months)
 Pain & suffering: Rs.20,000/-
 Attendant Expenses: Rs.5,000/-
 Transport Expenses: Rs.5000/-
 Special diet: Rs.5,000/-
 TOTAL: Rs.6,97,827/-

Amount awarded by the Tribunal: RS.5,61,927/-
 Amount to be enhanced : RS.1,35,900/-
 9] In view of the above, the appeal stands partly allowed.
compensation as awarded by the Claims Tribunal is accordingly enhanced by a sum of Rs.1,35,900/- (Rupees One Lakh Thirty Five thousand).
The enhanced amount will bear interest at the same rate as awarded by the Tribunal, and will govern by the same conditions as contained in the award of the Tribunal.
The appellant is directed to pay the Court fees on enhanced amount of compensation within a period of one month's time, in accordance with law.
